correctness.rationale: For the source's logistic maturation weights, \(Y_A\le y_1/2+y_2\) and \(Y_J\ge y_1/2\). Integrating the age equation with the renewal boundary condition and differentiating \(V=x+cy\) gives the exact upper bound with cross coefficients \(s+c(k-g)/2\) and \(-b+ck\). A positive constant \(c\) makes both nonpositive exactly when \(c(g-k)\ge2s\) and \(ck\le b\), equivalently \(g>k\) and \(2sk\le b(g-k)\) under the source's positive-parameter regime (with no upper bound when \(k=0\)). Then \(V'\le\max\{r,\|\widetilde B\|_\infty\}V\), so Gronwall bounds \(x+\|u\|_1\) on each finite horizon. The source's local Lipschitz construction on bounded balls and finite-horizon compact age support then give continuation. Concentrating age mass near the juvenile cutoff or far in the adult tail verifies sharpness only within the constant-weight \(x+c\int u\) family.
